questions.questionHtml: A tailor had to cut a certain number of shirts from rolls of full-length fabrics. He cut each roll into 11 pieces of equal length. He cut the rolls of fabrics at a rate of 50 cut per minute. How many rolls of fabric would he be able to cut in 25 minutes?
questions.solution:
Note: To make 11 pieces of equal length from 1 full roll, we need to cut 10 times.

Rate of cutting = 50 cuts per minute.

Therefore, no. of cuts in 25 minutes = 50 × 25 = 1250.

⇒ No. of rolls cuts in 25 minutes

= No. of cuts in 25 minutes ÷  No. of cuts required for 1 roll

= 1250 ÷ 10

= 125.

⇒ ∠AOP + 15° + 90° = 180°

⇒ ∠AOP = 75°

questions.question: If a sum of money on compound interest becomes three times in 4 years, then at the same interest rate, the sum will become 27 times in:
questions.questionHtml: If a sum of money on compound interest becomes three times in 4 years, then at the same interest rate, the sum will become 27 times in:
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

If a sum becomes n times in t years at compound interest, it becomes nx times in x × t years.

Given, sum becomes 3 times (31) in 4 years.

We need to find the time for the sum to become 27 times.

Since 27 = 33, the multiplier x = 3.

Time required = 3 × 4 = 12 years.

∴ The correct answer is 12 years.

Alternate Method

Given:

A sum of money at compound interest becomes 3 times in 4 years.

Let Principal = P, Rate = R%, Amount = A, Time = n years.

Formula Used:

A = P(1 + R/100)n

Calculations:

⇒ 3P = P(1 + R/100)4

⇒ 3 = (1 + R/100)4     — (Equation 1)

Let the sum become 27 times in n years.

⇒ 27P = P(1 + R/100)n

⇒ 27 = (1 + R/100)n

⇒ 33 = (1 + R/100)n

Substitute the value of 3 from Equation 1:

⇒ [(1 + R/100)4]3 = (1 + R/100)n

⇒ (1 + R/100)12 = (1 + R/100)n

On comparing the powers of both sides:

⇒ n = 12 years

∴ The correct answer is 12 years.

Additional Information

Compound Interest Multiplier Rule

If a sum becomes x times in T years at a constant compound interest rate, it will become xn times in n × T years.

Contrast with Simple Interest (SI)

In Simple Interest, if a sum becomes 3 times in 4 years, the interest earned is 2P in 4 years. To become 27 times, the required interest is 26P. It would take (26 ÷ 2) × 4 = 52 years in SI.

Important CI Formats

For half-yearly compounding: Rate becomes R/2 and Time becomes 2T. For quarterly compounding: Rate becomes R/4 and Time becomes 4T.

questions.question: If 3cos 2 A + 7sin 2 A = 3, 0° ≤ A ≤ 90°, then the value of A is:
questions.questionHtml: If 3cos<sup>2</sup> A + 7sin<sup>2</sup> A = 3, 0° ≤ A ≤ 90°, then the value of A is:
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Observe the equation 3cos2 A + 7sin2 A = 3.

Since the result is exactly the coefficient of the cos2 A term (3), the sin2 A term must be 0.

For 7sin2 A = 0, sin A must be 0.

In the range 0° ≤ A ≤ 90°, sin A = 0 only when A = 0°.

∴ The correct answer is 0°.

Alternate Method

Given: 3cos2 A + 7sin2 A = 3

Formula Used: sin2 A + cos2 A = 1 ⇒ sin2 A = 1 − cos2 A

⇒ 3cos2 A + 7(1 − cos2 A) = 3

⇒ 3cos2 A + 7 − 7cos2 A = 3

⇒ 7 − 4cos2 A = 3

⇒ 4cos2 A = 7 − 3

⇒ 4cos2 A = 4

⇒ cos2 A = 1

⇒ cos A = 1 (Since A is in the first quadrant)

⇒ A = cos−1(1) = 0°

∴ The correct answer is 0°.

Additional Information

Trigonometric Identities

Fundamental identity: sin2θ + cos2θ = 1. Other relations include 1 + tan2θ = sec2θ and 1 + cot2θ = cosec2θ.

Standard Values

At 0°: sin 0° = 0, cos 0° = 1, tan 0° = 0. At 90°: sin 90° = 1, cos 90° = 0, tan 90° is undefined.

Quadrant Rules

In the first quadrant (0° to 90°), all trigonometric ratios (sin, cos, tan, etc.) are positive.

Key Points

  • In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
  • In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
  • The given sentence is in the passive voice and 'The results' is the subject and 'us' is the object.
  • When we convert this sentence into active voice, the subject 'The results' of the passive voice becomes the object, the object 'us' becomes the subject ( subjective case of pronoun for us is 'we').
  • The passive format "will + be + V3" should be changed into the active format "will + V1 ".
  • This is the active and passive voice rule for the future simple tense.
  • Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
